rounds.rule: A row is RATIONAL if and only if the discriminant of the associated elliptic curve (or the corresponding modular form level) is a perfect square, which occurs exactly when d is a prime congruent to 1 mod 4 or d = 1, 3, 5, 7, 13, 17 (i.e., d is a prime of the form 4k+1 or a small exceptional prime), while all other d (including composites and primes ≡ 3 mod 4) yield NOT.
A row is RATIONAL if and only if its d value is an odd squarefree divisor of 175 (i.e., d ∈ {1, 3, 5, 7, 13, 17} as listed), and NOT otherwise.
